source: Meta Ad Library (India, active ads) + the company's own live website

ads.text: Tired of your electricity bill going up every summer? Put your rooftop to work. Meissa Reeve designs and installs rooftop solar for homes across Hyderabad - so you generate your own power and cut your monthly bill. Free site visit & savings estimate; Help with the PM Surya Ghar subsidy process; End-to-end installation & net metering. Tap 'Send WhatsApp message' and tell us your monthly bill - we'll show you how much you can save. #HarGharSolar

ad_library.summary: Meissa Reeve is running exactly one active Meta ad, on the 'Meissa Reeve' page (facebook.com/61596697943588), started 14 Nov 2026 and roughly 18 hours old when it was re-checked. The click lands on a WhatsApp deep link - never on meissareeve.com. Google Ads Transparency for meissareeve.com returns 0 ads under region=IN, so Meta is the entire paid channel and it rests on a single creative.

funnel.destination: wa.me deep link behind the 'Send WhatsApp message' CTA
funnel.meaning: Every click becomes a WhatsApp conversation with a salesperson. That is workable, but nothing is measurable: no pixel, no conversion event, no audience of people who clicked and went quiet, and no page where a different headline or price could be tested.

findings: One ad, one message, one channel. The whole paid programme is a single creative launched on 14 Nov 2026 - there is no second angle to compare against and nothing running behind it if this one fatigues.

The ad sends the click to WhatsApp, not to the website. re.meissareeve.com carries the residential, commercial, industrial and agricultural rooftop work plus four named installations, and none of the paid traffic ever lands on it.

The copy does the qualifying work WhatsApp cannot: it asks for the monthly bill and names the three things that actually decide a solar sale - free site visit, PM Surya Ghar subsidy handling, end-to-end installation with net metering.

The parent company runs three divisions (solar re., enter e., EV ev.) and the ad is only about solar, which is the right call - but it means the solar division has to win on its own with one creative.

Zero Google ads under region=IN. For a search term as intent-heavy as 'solar panel installation Hyderabad' that is an open channel, and the WhatsApp funnel means there is no landing page to send that traffic to yet.
next_steps: Give the WhatsApp click somewhere to land
A single page on re.meissareeve.com with the offer, the subsidy explainer and an enquiry form, so the click is measurable and retargetable even while WhatsApp stays the primary conversion.
Run a second angle against the first

The current ad leads on bill savings. A second creative leading on the PM Surya Ghar subsidy - the number, the paperwork, the timeline - tests a different motive without touching the one that is working.
Put the four named installs to work
Anees 2 kW Moula Ali, Dr. Kasi 3 kW R K Puram, Om Prakash 4 kW Balnagar and Uma Shankar 3 kW Begumpet are real, local and verifiable. They belong next to the offer, not only on a projects page.
No Google ads at all. The subsidy and the free site visit are exactly the queries Hyderabad homeowners type, and there is currently no paid presence on any of them.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
